visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A medium-sized brown dog stands on wet concrete; a person in beige shorts stands behind it, applying soap to its wet fur. (2) Close-up on the dog's face as it is sprayed with water from a hose; its ears are pinned back and it looks sorrowful. (3) Hands in red rubber gloves vigorously scrub pink soap into the dog's facial fur; the dog's eyes are partially closed. (4) The rinsing process continues with a white spray nozzle; the background shows green garden plants and a portion of a house. (5) A brown towel is used to dry the dog's head and neck. (6) A hand holds a transparent bag of treats in front of the dog; the dog sits attentively. (7) The dog is now on a bright green lawn, wagging its tail and being petted by a woman in a grey t-shirt.
